title: Light Algerian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Algerian dish featuring fatty and crumbly lamb, infused with dried mint and char-grilled to perfection, this recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together dried mint, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb with olive oil and lemon juice.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional dried mint if desired.
